definitions.VERIFIED: At least 95% of the left table's rows found a match on the right under this transform. Safe to join on; any rows that did not match are listed as orphans.
definitions.PARTIAL: Between 80% and 95% of the left table's rows found a match. Usable with care: the orphans listed drop out of any join on this key.
definitions.REJECTED: Fewer than 80% of the left table's rows found a match. This key does not join the two tables with this transform.
definitions.rate: Match rate = matched rows / rows of the left table. The verdict is read from this rate.
definitions.rate_distinct: The same count over distinct key values instead of rows. Shown beside the verdict, never used for it (it misreads a column such as SIC, where 43 utilities share 4 codes).
definitions.orphan: A left-table value with no match on the right side (at most 10 are listed).
definitions.left: The left table is the one whose rows the measuring statement counts.
definitions.recalled: Not measured in this run: recalled from a key memory that an earlier run measured as VERIFIED. The numbers, orphans and SQL are those of that earlier measurement.
definitions.measured: Measured in this run by the Lightning SQL statement shown, over cached views.
